title: Rory and the Velvet Moss Cavern
verses:
The stars started winking above in the dark,
As Rory walked slowly across the deep glade.
A sparkling blue fly left a glowing bright mark,
And guided the crew to a shadowy shade.

Inside of a cavern where velvet moss grew,
Then Nia flew down on a shadow of wings.
When Psittaco nestled in petals of blue,
To listen to music the nighttime air brings.

As Benny rested his neck on the ground,
And Tilly snuggled where shadows were deep.
A quiet and cozy warm comfort was found,
To help all the travelers drift into sleep.

Now Ricky stopped darting and slowed down his pace,
He gave a big yawn as he rested his feet.
He found a warm hollow inside of the place,
And curled up to dream of a cozy retreat.

Then Rory looked round at his friends in the cave,
His heart was so happy and full of pure peace.
The stillness was gentle and soft as a wave,
That bade every worry and wiggle to cease.

The glowing moss shined with a silver-blue light,
While moonbeams dropped down through a crack in the crest.
The cave held them all through the beautiful night,
As Rory closed eyes for a wonderful rest.

title: Rory and the Glowing Meadow
verses:
The stars started blinking above the grand peak,
As Rory walked slowly along the cool stream.
Young Psittaco chirped of a magic to seek,
Where moss in the valley would sparkle and gleam.

High up in the twilight, sweet Nia swooped round,
To guide the small group through the velvet-soft glade.
While Ricky paused softly and laid on the ground,
To watch how the light made the shadows all fade.

Brave Tilly found hollows where silver fern grows,
And Benny leaned low with a rumble so mild.
The pathway was lit where the night-blossom blows,
To welcome each tired and wandering child.

Soft Rory stepped into the shimmering nook,
Where glowing green petals swayed light in the breeze.
They rested their feet by a murmuring brook,
Underneath the tall crowns of the sleepy old trees.

Small Psittaco tucked under Rory's green chin,
While Nia tucked neatly inside a soft nest.
The gentle night whispers began to flow in,
To signal it's time for the forest to rest.

Now Tilly let out a soft sigh of content,
And Benny gave one final comforting hum.
With sweet sleepy feelings where dreamers are sent,
The peaceful goodnight to the valley had come.

title: Rory and the Starlit Glade
verses:
When the sun drifted down past the hills in the west,
And the valley was filled with a shimmering shade,
Gentle Rory called out that it was time for a rest,
And he led all his friends to a cozy night glade.

High above them flew Nia, who watched from the sky,
While Psittaco nestled down deep in her wing.
As the moon rose so high and the breezes blew by,
The tiny guide whispered a song he would sing.

Quick Ricky was prancing with energy still,
But Tilly found leaves that were cozy and deep.
She slowed his fast feet near the foot of the hill,
And helped him prepare for a wonderful sleep.

Huge Benny sank down like a mountain of gray,
His heavy feet resting upon the soft moss.
He sighed as the last of the light faded away,
While starlight danced gently and silver across.

The blossoms of blue started closing their heads,
As twilight came down on the moss-covered ground.
The friends curled up close in their softest of beds,
Without a single huff or a whisper of sound.

Then Rory yawned wide as he tucked in his tail,
And watched as the stars gave a soft, cozy light.
A slumbery breeze drifted over the vale,
To wish all the dinosaurs peace and goodnight.

title: Rory and the Lantern Tree Glade
verses:
The stars started blinking above in the sky,
As Rory walked softly through mosses so deep.
A cozy cool breeze gave a velvety sigh,
And promised the forest it soon was for sleep.

Sweet Nia soared down through the silver-lit shade,
While Psittaco chirped from his snug cozy nest.
Big Benny marched slow through the sweet-scented glade,
To join gentle Rory for bedtime and rest.

Wild Ricky slowed down as he rested his feet,
And Tilly brought leaves that were fragrant and dry.
They gathered around where the pine branches meet,
To watch the soft lanterns of bugs drifting by.

Young Rory laid moss on the cozy green floor,
To make a soft cushion so plush and so warm.
The night gently settled and closed up its door,
To keep all the dino-friends safe from the storm.

The moon cast a glow on each weary green head,
As Psittaco snuggled near Nia’s soft wing.
Big Benny yawned slow as he stretched in his bed,
Content with the lullaby night-crickets sing.

Then Rory breathed out as he closed both his eyes,
And cuddled up close to his friends in the dark.
Beneath the calm glow of the starry-lit skies,
Sleep landed as soft as a flickering spark.

title: Rory and the Silver Moss Valley
verses:
The moon had arisen above the dark trees,
When Psittaco chirped from a moss-covered nest.
High up in the air flew sweet Nia with ease,
To lead all her friends to a valley of rest.

The moss was as soft as a pillow of green,
Beside a clear stream where the water rolled slow.
Sweet Tilly stepped down with a smile so serene,
As Benny sank deep in the shadows below.

Sturdy Ricky stretched out on a carpet of blue,
And rested his chin on his heavy front paw.
Tiny Psittaco snuggled in leaves wet with dew,
With feelings of comfort and magical awe.

Big Rory curled up with a sleepy green tail,
He yawned at the stars as they started to gleam.
A soft silvery light drifted down on the vale,
To carry the friends on a whispering dream.

The night-crickets sang in a quiet refrain,
While Nia tucked wings on a warm rocky ledge.
No shadow or worry was left to remain,
Safe out on the quiet and velvety edge.

So hush now, sweet child, while the silver stars keep
Their watch on the world in a magical glow.
For now it is time to fall softly asleep,
Where peaceful and beautiful dream-rivers flow.

title: The Secret of the Whispering Falls
verses:
The sun dipped away behind ridges of blue,
When Nia swooped low with a chirp of delight.
She led all her friends through the shimmering dew,
To find where the waterfall glowed in the night.

Behind the cool spray was a wide, hidden shelf,
Where giant soft ferns caught the mist in the air.
Each dinosaur found a dry spot for itself,
Content with the magical calm waiting there.

Psittaco gathered dry leaves in a heap,
And made a small cushion right next to the wall.
His chirps turned to whispers, preparing for sleep,
Entranced by the soothing cascade of the fall.

Then Ricky and Benny worked side by side now,
To roll a large boulder to block out the chill.
With teamwork complete and a yawn from the brow,
They felt all the bustle of daytime go still.

Sweet Tilly leaned close to the thunder-soft sound,
Her heavy tail resting along the damp stone.
A blanket of tranquility settled around,
Ensuring that nobody rested alone.

Green Rory sank down with a satisfied sigh,
His mighty green tail curled up close to his chest.
With moon-shadows drifting across the dark sky,
The friends closed their eyes and surrendered to rest.
